subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Drug i. hope left for the i. leads a man to death (b) When there is no ii. of drug is ii. in Bangladesh (c) The frequent iii. is acute iii. brain (d) The effect iv. damages iv. very poisonous (e) Drug problem v. taking of drugs v. young people they get addicted to drug
guide_solution: Matching (a) Drug damages brain. (b) When there is no hope left for the young people they addict to drug. (c) The frequent taking of drugs leads a man to death. (d) The effect of drug is very poisonous. (e) Drug problem is acute in Bangladesh.
